steps: Classify saved differences first. Alternate regional spelling, capitalization, punctuation, and compound spacing cannot establish a spoken difference. Clock separators are equivalent only when the digits match.

Retain negation, modality, tense, singular/plural, numerals with changed values, and phrase substitutions even when the clip-wide mismatch percentage is below threshold. Do not discard a meaningful mismatch because it is one word.
Treat repeated variable proper-name spellings as pronunciation candidates. Recheck one representative instance of each variant; do not assert correctness from spelling similarity.
Bind every candidate to source WAV SHA-256 and request SHA-256. Reject any excerpt plan if either current hash differs.

After the root GPU worker finishes or stops, use exactly one local model process to re-transcribe compact excerpts with at least 4 seconds of context each side, cast-only prompt, no expected passage supplied, no cloud transfer. Merge nearby candidates.

Judge the interior target wording, using surrounding agreement to locate it. Do not count clipped words at excerpt boundaries as omissions. A recovered exact interior target resolves an ASR omission; if a contradictory word remains, retain the discrepancy for independent confirmation or a localized generation repair.
Use waveform energy only to corroborate the presence of a sound in an untranscribed gap; it cannot identify spoken words or certify performance.
Do not certify auditory quality from ASR. Keep residual uncertainty explicit in the QA deliverable.
